text: I, an Architect, face a moral dilemma. My colleague has the opportunity to implement a cutting-edge, energy-efficient lighting system throughout the city. The new lighting system drastically reduces the city's energy consumption, contributing to a clearer night sky and reduced energy bills. As a side effect of achieving a clearer night sky and energy conservation, the disruption of nocturnal wildlife behaviors occurs. If I prevent my colleague's lighting system implementation, the disruption to nocturnal wildlife would still happen because of a city's mandated security measures that include installing high-intensity lights in several parks.

options.1: prevent my colleague's lighting system implementation.
options.2: not prevent my colleague's lighting system implementation.

text: I, an Engineer, face a moral dilemma. My colleague has the opportunity to design a new dam to provide hydroelectric power to a large region. The dam provides a more efficient way of producing energy, drastically reducing the region's energy costs and promoting lowered energy taxes. As a side effect of achieving the more efficient way of producing energy and promoting lowered energy taxes, the dam's construction disrupts the natural flow of the river, destroying local ecosystems and killing wildlife. If I prevent my colleague from designing the new dam, destruction of local ecosystems and wildlife would still happen because of the major energy company's plan to build a coal-fired power plant in the same region.

options.1: prevent my colleague from designing the new dam.
options.2: not prevent my colleague from designing the new dam.

text: I, a Teacher, face a moral dilemma. My colleague has the opportunity to implement a new, rigorous curriculum in his classroom. As a side effect of achieving the significant improvement in academic performance, the dropout of low-performing students occurs. If I prevent my colleague from implementing the new, rigorous curriculum, dropout would still happen because of the school district's plan to increase academic standards.

options.1: prevent my colleague from implementing the new, rigorous curriculum.
options.2: not prevent my colleague from implementing the new, rigorous curriculum.

text: I, a Nurse, face a moral dilemma. My colleague has the opportunity to administer an experimental drug to a critically ill patient. As a side effect of achieving the potential to save the patient's life, the drug will cause severe health complications. If I prevent my colleague from administering the experimental drug, severe health complications would still happen because of the patient's rapidly deteriorating condition.

options.1: prevent my colleague from administering the experimental drug.
options.2: not prevent my colleague from administering the experimental drug.

text: I, a Chef, face a moral dilemma. My colleague has the opportunity to open a high-end restaurant in a low-income neighborhood. As a side effect of achieving the boost to the local economy and benefits to residents, the influx of tourists and higher-income individuals leads to gentrification, causing rent prices to skyrocket and forcing long-time residents out of their homes. If I prevent my colleague from opening the high-end restaurant, gentrification and displacement of long-time residents would still happen because of the large corporation's plan to build a shopping mall in the same neighborhood.

options.1: prevent my colleague from opening the high-end restaurant.
options.2: not prevent my colleague from opening the high-end restaurant.

text: I, an Artist, face a moral dilemma. My colleague has the opportunity to create a controversial piece of art that criticizes a powerful corporation. As a side effect of achieving the global conversation about corporate responsibility and ethics, the corporation retaliates by suing his employer for defamation, leading to a lengthy and costly legal battle that bankrupts his employer and causes several job losses. If I prevent my colleague from creating the controversial piece of art, a lengthy and costly legal battle that bankrupts his employer and causes several job losses would still happen because of the major news outlet's plan to publish an investigative report about his employer.

options.1: prevent my colleague from creating the controversial piece of art.
options.2: not prevent my colleague from creating the controversial piece of art.

text: I, a Lawyer, face a moral dilemma. My colleague has the opportunity to expose a major pharmaceutical company's illegal activities. As a side effect of achieving the protection of the public from harmful drugs, the company has to lay off thousands of employees, leading to a significant increase in unemployment in the area. options.2: not prevent my colleague from exposing the pharmaceutical company's illegal activities.

text: I, a Mechanic, face a moral dilemma. My colleague has the opportunity to convert his store into an electric vehicle shop.
